Definition: from G2479; forcible (literally or figuratively):--boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.
BiblicalUsage: Strong is the word for power that cannot be moved, and the Bible gives it to God and to his people in turn. In 1 Corinthians 1:25 the weakness of God is stronger than men, in 1 John 2:14 the young men are strong because the word of God abides in them, in Hebrews 5:7 Jesus offers prayers with strong crying and tears, and in Hebrews 6:18 God gives strong consolation to those who flee for refuge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe true strength is the kind that cries out and holds on: Jesus prayed with strong crying. God answers with strong consolation.
